bash: cd /app && python3 -c "
import zipfile,hashlib,base64
z=zipfile.ZipFile('dist/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl')
names=z.namelist()
print('entries:',names)
assert 'vectorops/__init__.py' in names
di=[n for n in names if n.startswith('vectorops-0.1.0.dist-info/RECORD')][0]
bad=0
for line in z.read(di).decode().splitlines():
    p,h,s=line.split(',')
    if not h: continue
    data=z.read(p)
    d=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
    ok = ('sha256='+d==h) and (str(len(data))==s)
    print(('OK  ' if ok else 'BAD '),p)
    bad += 0 if ok else 1
print('RECORD mismatches:',bad)
print('WHEEL:',z.read('vectorops-0.1.0.dist-info/WHEEL').decode().strip().replace(chr(10),' | '))
print('METADATA:',z.read('vectorops-0.1.0.dist-info/METADATA').decode().strip().replace(chr(10),' | '))
"
